entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker and ancient vampire with light pupils and black scleras who carries an ornate longsword.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings that rose and threatened Zendikar the first time, witnessed by Sorin.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane the Eldrazi rose to threaten; its flavor is bridged with Mirrodin by Buried Ruin.

entities.name: Vaasgoth
entities.description: A benighted region, not a plane, where a vampire warlord commands a legion of vampiric thralls.

entities.name: Thune
entities.description: A kingdom presumed to lie on one of the planes of the Multiverse.

entities.name: Kalonia
entities.description: Uncivilized forests presumed to lie on one of the planes.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A plane with an artifact-laden identity.

entities.name: Skinshifter
entities.description: A beastmaster nature mage who can alter his appearance and become one of the living creatures of the forest he reveres.

events.summary: Sorin's Vengeance depicts Sorin ramming his blade into a would-be swordsman's heart, drawing the victim's blood up the blade into himself.
events.quote: Sorin's Vengeance depicts him ramming said blade into the heart of a victim

events.summary: The author warns against staying the night in Vaasgoth, home of a vampire warlord and his thralls.
events.quote: don't stay the night in Vaasgoth.

relations.note: Sorin is old enough to have seen the Eldrazi rise and threaten Zendikar the first time
relations.quote: old enough to have seen the Eldrazi rise and threaten Zendikar the first time out
